gloss: to move up (in time/schedule); to advance; to promote

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {繰|く}り{上|あ}げませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {繰|く}り{上|あ}げていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {繰|く}り{上|あ}げていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to move up; to advance (a date or time)
definitions.explanation: To reschedule something to happen earlier than originally planned.

definitions.gloss: to promote; to move up (in rank or position)
definitions.explanation: To advance someone to a higher position, often due to a vacancy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧1⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: We moved up the meeting schedule by one week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予報|よほう}→予報：03668_yohou⟧⟦なので→なので：29354_nanode⟧⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げて⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施：03275_jisshi⟧。
examples.english: Since rain is forecast, we'll hold the sports day earlier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We decided to move the departure time up by thirty minutes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{欠員|けついん}→欠員：14787_ketsuin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{次点|じてん}→次点：noentry⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦{当選|とうせん}した→当選：07074_tousen⟧。
examples.english: Due to a vacancy, the runner-up was promoted to winner.
examples.notes: {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ{当選|とうせん} is a set term for winning by advancement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{辞|や}めた→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げて⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Since the person above him quit, he was promoted to department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{補欠|ほけつ}→補欠：16029_hoketsu⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦レギュラー→レギュラー：11396_regyuraa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The substitute player was promoted to the regular lineup.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: you {繰|く}り{上|あ}げる a date, a time, or a person's position. The intransitive idea is expressed by the noun form {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ, as in {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる (to bring a schedule forward)
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げる (to move a time earlier)
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧ (winning a seat because someone above you withdrew)
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦{返済|へんさい}→返済：04776_hensai⟧ (paying off a loan ahead of schedule)

SIMILAR VERBS:
- ⟦{繰|く}り{下|さ}げる→繰り下げる：07262_kurisageru⟧ - the opposite operation, moving something later.
- ⟦{早|はや}める→早める：04587_hayameru⟧ - to make something happen sooner in general; {繰|く}り{上|あ}げる specifically shifts a fixed slot in a sequence, so it suits schedules, rankings, and queues.
